Compression points remain discrete; no interpolation, unloading, creep, isotropic Young modulus or Poisson ratio is inferred. Service limits and glass-transition/melting temperatures do not extend property validity. Data were generated immediately after machining in source-described standard climate Germany; neither a numerical temperature/humidity nor dry-as-molded or equilibrium-conditioned moisture content is inferred. Tensile strength 85 MPa is distinct from the source's 84 MPa yield strength.
